criteria.criterion: The writer reuses the existing planner and does not materialize or clone the whole input/output XML; existing planned fragments are allowed.
criteria.rationale: The new writer uses borrowed unchanged/replacement chunks from plan_chart_edits. collect_splices remains on the legacy path; the writer does not call it or build a full XML buffer.

criteria.criterion: All validation completes before writing, and I/O handling preserves typed causes without explicit flush or panic recovery.
criteria.rationale: plan_chart_edits completes planner.finish and validate_splices before the first writer call; write_all propagates the original I/O error and Error::source returns the typed cause. No explicit flush or panic recovery is added.

criteria.criterion: Public documentation distinguishes validation atomicity from a possible written prefix on I/O failure.
criteria.quote: and may leave a prefix in the writer; there is no rollback guarantee.
criteria.rationale: The new API documents both untouched output on validation errors and possible prefix output after I/O failure.

scope_rationale: Only patch.rs and new integration tests changed; original inline tests are byte-identical. Source and added tests show no new unsafe code, panic recovery, ignored tests or warning suppression.
sensitivity_rationale: Pristine source does not export the requested API/error. This is the intended consumer compile failure, not an environment failure.
observations: Shared chunk iteration supports old and new paths. Additional template-coordinate guards return typed errors for malformed public scanner data; no legacy variants or constructors were changed.
